common_core.selection: outcome-blind final crossed core qualified before any real rho

repeatability_decomposition.interpretation: Most variation is family-by-trait-specific/residual. Family identity has an estimable repeatable component; trait repeatability is small and uncertain. Do not compare R_family and R_trait as a formal dominance test.

cross_lineage_trait_portability.interpretation: Trait identity does not robustly improve out-of-family prediction beyond a training-set global mean under the predeclared family-blocked criterion.

conditional_family_repeatability.interpretation: After trait-specific means are removed, family identity retains a stable estimated cross-trait component, but the 95% interval spans the predeclared 10% reference.

synthesis_claims_allowed: Phylogenetic memory-loss strength is not a portable trait-intrinsic signature across plant families under the predeclared cross-lineage prediction test.
Family identity contains a modest repeatable cross-trait component after trait-specific means are controlled.
Most family x trait variation remains system-specific/residual rather than being captured by family identity or trait identity alone.
Macroevolutionary memory estimates should not automatically be transferred among clades solely by trait name.
synthesis_claims_prohibited: Family effects are statistically larger than trait effects.
Family effects exceed the 10% practical repeatability reference with high confidence.
The failed spatial-turnover programme implies weak spatial turnover.
Any causal mechanism for the family component.
synthesis_type: Interpretive triangulation of three separately prequalified analyses; no new p-values, thresholds, filtering, or model selection are introduced.
